summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Superadmin Dashboard features. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Fixed MongoDB projection bug in GET /api/superadmin/institutions/{id}. Frontend verified: Superadmin Dashboard at /superadmin displays all stats, institutions list with enriched data, activity log, exam distribution. SMS/WhatsApp toggle in Institution Settings is clickable and working correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/superadmin/stats - Returns platform_stats, exam_stats, ai_stats, growth_stats, business_metrics
GET /api/superadmin/institutions - Returns institutions list with enriched data (ai_credits, student_count, activity_this_week, has_zoom_configured, has_messaging_configured)
GET /api/superadmin/institutions/{id} - Returns detailed institution info with students, settings, credits, exam_stats
GET /api/superadmin/activity-log - Returns recent platform activities (exam, ai, registration)
GET /api/superadmin/activity-log?activity_type=exam - Filter by activity type works
POST /api/superadmin/grant-credits - Grants credits to institution successfully
Superadmin login - Admin user with is_superadmin:true can login

bugs_fixed.issue: MongoDB projection error - mixing inclusion and exclusion fields
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to exclusion-only projection and filtered fields in Python

seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin and institution accounts
context_for_next_testing_agent: Superadmin Dashboard fully tested: 1) All 6 API endpoints working (stats, institutions, institutions/{id}, activity-log, revenue-report, grant-credits). 2) Frontend at /superadmin shows all stats cards, institutions list with search, activity log, exam distribution. 3) Grant Credits modal works. 4) SMS/WhatsApp toggle in Institution Settings is clickable and functional. 5) Fixed MongoDB projection bug in get_institution_details endpoint.

mocked_apis_list: POST /api/institution/messaging/test - simulates sending test message (no actual SMS/WhatsApp sent)
POST /api/institution/messaging/send-bulk - queues messages but doesn't actually send

backend.superadmin_stats: GET /api/superadmin/stats - platform_stats, exam_stats, ai_stats, growth_stats, business_metrics
backend.superadmin_institutions: GET /api/superadmin/institutions - list with enriched data, search, pagination
backend.superadmin_institution_details: GET /api/superadmin/institutions/{id} - detailed info with students, settings, credits
backend.superadmin_activity_log: GET /api/superadmin/activity-log - recent activities with type filter
backend.superadmin_grant_credits: POST /api/superadmin/grant-credits - grant AI credits to institutions

frontend.superadmin_dashboard: Stats cards (Institutions, Students, Active Users, Exams), AI stats (Interactions, Credits, Revenue), Institutions list with search, Activity log, Exam distribution, Grant Credits modal
frontend.institution_settings_sms_tab: WhatsApp & SMS Configuration with Enable Messaging toggle (clickable), Provider selection (16 providers), Credentials inputs, Phone number inputs, Enable SMS/WhatsApp toggles

zoom_integration_note: Zoom router exists at /app/backend/routers/zoom.py but requires institution to configure their own Zoom credentials. Not tested as it requires real Zoom API credentials.
